plots.title: Kuraray spectral loss: YS-4, YS-6 and Y-11 proxy
plots.source_note: Kuraray meeting, 13 November 2026, page 7; Y-11 is a declared substitute
plots.notes:
Y-11 proxy: mean of YS-4/YS-6 coefficients. Ordinary loss uses the red curve, held below 520 nm.
The blue excess is assigned to WLS reabsorption; no scalar 4 m loss is added.

plots.title: Spectral loss budget: Kuraray Y-11 substitute
plots.source_note: Kuraray p.7; decomposition is an explicit model assumption, not separately measured PS/PMMA data
plots.notes:
Within measured support at 200 effective ppm, the two rates sum to the input curve.
Blue absorption <=480 nm is retained; a log-coefficient bridge joins the weak red tail.
